name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-llm-tool-call-guard
description: Runaway tool-call argument guard for dsh: wrap the llm/stream waterfall and cut a tool call that streams more than a configurable number of arguments bytes (UTF-8, maxArgsBytes) or fragments (maxArgsFragments), terminating with a routed error finish so the oversized call is never executed. Also supports a whole-request aggregate budget (maxTotalArgsBytes) that bounds the cumulative arguments across all tool-call blocks. Distinct codes: TOOL_CALL_ARGUMENTS_TOO_LARGE (per-call bytes), TOOL_CALL_ARGUMENTS_TOO_MANY_FRAGMENTS (per-call fragments), TOOL_CALL_ARGUMENTS_TOTAL_TOO_LARGE (whole-request). Compatible with dsh 0.1.5-alpha.2 (agent loop never executes a tool-call when the stream ends on an error/aborted finish).
